sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, opening paragraphs through note 4. Odoacer in 476, the eastern emperor Zeno’s mandate, the Italian campaign in 489, the agreement and killing in 493, and Theoderic’s death in 526.
Paragraphs around notes 84–88. Athalaric, his minority and his mother Amalasuentha’s regency, the accession letters and the promised continuation of rights.

note.de: 493 rief das Heer Theoderich nach dem Einzug in Ravenna zum König in Italien aus. Als Anführer der Goten trug er den Königstitel bereits zuvor.
note.en: The army acclaimed Theoderic as king in Italy after his entry into Ravenna in 493. He had already held the royal title as leader of the Goths.
